api.construction: TriggerPolicy(loaded_v2v_policy, v2v_dim=48, n_candidates=<registered budget>, partner_slots=5, freeze_base=True, moves_api=None). Also supports existing V2V-only width 24. Width must exactly match loaded actor. moves_api=None lazily imports tools.coopmwm.moves.
api.base_policy: forward(context), sample(...), score(sample) delegate unchanged to the existing V2V/intent actor. Construction preserves global torch RNG state. Frozen trigger updates leave all base state_dict tensors and sampled actions/noise/logp byte-identical.
api.decide: policy.decide(context, obs_states={ego: local_observable_state}, observable_cavs={ego: ordered_local_CAV_ids_including_ego}, rng=numpy_rng, generator=torch_cpu_generator, deterministic=False) -> TriggerBatch. Caller owns decision cadence. Each ego gets moves.candidates(obs_states[ego], rng, n_candidates) once.
api.discrete_actions: 0=none; 1..N=joint family/partners/parameters candidate bucket. Candidate scoring uses the existing per-CAV 64-wide actor trunk plus family one-hot, observable member-slot mask and onset/hold/depth normalized by VARIETY_REGISTERED. Unused action slots are masked. No new behavioural ranges or family names are invented.
api.move_contract: moves.FAMILIES includes none; moves.candidates(obs_state, rng, n) -> moves; each non-none Move exposes family, members, onset_s, hold_s, depth as attributes or mapping fields. moves.offsets(move, elapsed_s) -> {cav_id: accel_offset}. Candidates require 1..4 unique observable CAV members including ego and registered variety parameter ranges.
api.rollout: TriggerBatch stores deep-copied context and move tables, descriptors, availability mask, per-CAV actions, detached old logp and detached values. batch.selected() -> {ego: selected_Move_or_None}. evaluate(batch) -> per-CAV (logp, value, entropy); scoring never resamples candidates.
api.optimizer: policy.optimizer(lr=<registered learning rate>) owns exactly learning_parameters(). Frozen mode: trigger score/value heads only. Explicit freeze_base=False: also actor+broadcast; base critic, intent head and Gaussian log_std remain outside this optimizer.
api.ppo_update: ppo_update(policy, optimizer, batch, per_cav_advantages, per_cav_returns, clip_ratio=..., value_weight=..., entropy_weight=..., max_grad_norm=...) -> scalar loss/policy_loss/value_loss/entropy/approx_kl/clip_fraction/grad_norm/cav_count. One clipped minibatch step, no silent advantage normalization; caller owns GAE, epochs and any registered KL stopping budget. Rejects wrong optimizer ownership, empty batches, nonfinite or mismatched vectors and masked actions.
api.imitation: policy.imitation_loss(batch, target_action_indices) -> masked-table cross entropy for T2B/T2D. Targets must refer to the recorded table, not a fresh draw.
api.checkpoint: Standard policy.state_dict()/load_state_dict(strict=True) plus trigger optimizer.state_dict() and generator.get_state(). Reconstruct with the SAME constructor settings, moves family ordering and variety registration. CPU roundtrip and exact next-step optimizer parity tested.
api.execution_start: MoveExecutor(moves_api=None).start(move, ego=..., observable_cav_ids=..., now=..., until=...) -> accepted bool. until is explicit caller-registered commitment expiry. None abstains. Overlapping committed member sets are rejected atomically; callers can use stable ego order. No assumptions about a release tail beyond moves.offsets.
api.execution_requests: executor.requests(base_actions, native_commands, now=..., eligible_cav_ids=..., feasible_bounds={vid: (lo,hi)}) -> {vid: {requested_raw, acceleration_residual}}. base_actions are ABSOLUTE native+MAPPO commands. Offset is added to that base, clamped to per-tick feasibility and the shared 1.2 m/s^2 CAV cap. Departed/ineligible/non-CAV members are skipped. Unaffected base requests are not rewritten.
api.controller_integration: Merge executor requests into the existing acceleration/controller request dictionary BEFORE the existing feasibility and CommandOwnership single-writer stage. Retain existing speedMode 27 safe-speed handling. This module neither writes TraCI nor changes controller configuration. T2C supplies causal local obs/V2V identities, cadence, eligibility, bounds and commitment expiry. T2D can use frozen trigger features/heads and its own registered layer optimizer/KL budget.
